findings.description: No key_policy is defined, so AWS applies the default key policy granting full access (kms:*) to the account root user, meaning any IAM principal with sufficiently broad IAM permissions can administer or use this key. For an audit trail encryption key, explicit least-privilege key policy controls should be defined rather than relying on the default.

The resource does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation of the KMS key material is disabled by default, weakening key management hygiene for a key protecting audit trail data.
